source: Canonical embedded registries; no invented operation identifiers

functions.label: Prihlasit se
functions.enabledWhen: username,password locally valid AND not pending
functions.disabledWhen: missing field OR local invalid OR throttle/lock active OR request pending

functions.label: Ověřit
functions.enabledWhen: exactly one of valid TOTP/recovery inputs present AND not pending
functions.disabledWhen: both empty OR conflicting modes OR pending

functions.label: Zobrazit ruční seed
functions.disabledWhen: MFA already active OR session not enrollment

functions.label: Kopírovat recovery kódy
functions.enabledWhen: fresh enrollment completion response contains codes

functions.label: Odeslat
functions.enabledWhen: message has content OR attachment/url/target reference AND model capability ready
functions.disabledWhen: empty submission OR OPENAI_CONFIGURATION_REQUIRED for AI turn OR pending same submit

functions.label: Upravit směr
functions.enabledWhen: turn nonterminal AND operation permits steer

auditEvents.chat.turn.steer: Every admission, transition, child reservation, outcome and manual-review decision records logicalOperationId, correlationId, actor/channel and before/after digests.

functions.label: Zrušit běh
functions.disabledWhen: no cancellable turn OR cancellation already committed

functions.label: Otevřít web
functions.enabledWhen: browser capability available AND valid target URL/intention
functions.disabledWhen: browser capability unavailable OR recovery barrier

functions.label: Převzít ovládání
functions.enabledWhen: session READY/PAUSED and controller != OWNER and no incompatible transfer pending

functions.label: Vrátit AI
functions.enabledWhen: OWNER holds current control lease AND AI consumer attached AND challenge resolved
functions.disabledWhen: OWNER not controller OR stale epoch OR unresolved challenge

functions.label: Vybrat prvek
functions.enabledWhen: live preview current and document identity current
functions.disabledWhen: no current document OR preview stale

functions.label: Uložit účet
functions.enabledWhen: authenticated account marker verified and state save eligible
functions.disabledWhen: account not verified OR possible mutation unresolved

functions.label: Zavřít relaci
functions.enabledWhen: session closeable and no blocking unknown effect

functions.label: Propojit
functions.enabledWhen: source,target selected AND compatibility PASS AND versions current

functions.label: Odpojit
functions.enabledWhen: active binding selected and impact preview complete
functions.disabledWhen: binding not removable OR protected activation set

functions.label: Připojit secret
functions.enabledWhen: source revision and secret version selector valid

functions.label: Aktivovat
functions.enabledWhen: all blocking readiness gates PASS and candidate current
functions.disabledWhen: any gate not PASS OR current pointer conflict

functions.label: Zapnout
functions.enabledWhen: action registry enables for current state

functions.label: Vypnout
functions.enabledWhen: action registry enables for current state

functions.label: Opravit
functions.enabledWhen: repair eligible and no duplicate active repair
functions.disabledWhen: no evidence/eligible target OR repair already active

functions.label: Nové zadání
functions.disabledWhen: create pending OR platform recovery barrier

functions.label: Upravit směr
functions.enabledWhen: job nonterminal and current phase steerable

functions.label: Schválit specifikaci
functions.enabledWhen: spec current, all required questions resolved, validation PASS
functions.disabledWhen: open question, stale revision, invalid spec, missing authority

functions.label: Vyřešit blocker
functions.enabledWhen: blocker OPEN and required input valid
functions.disabledWhen: no open blocker OR invalid/stale blocker

functions.label: Opakovat
functions.enabledWhen: current failed phase exposes retry directive allowing retry

functions.label: Nová revize
functions.enabledWhen: agent exists and lifecycle allows revision

functions.label: Uložit revizi
functions.enabledWhen: candidate dirty and local/schema validation PASS
functions.disabledWhen: read-only active revision OR validation errors

functions.label: Spustit
functions.enabledWhen: active ready revision, bindings current, OpenAI configured
functions.disabledWhen: not active/ready OR stale binding OR OPENAI_CONFIGURATION_REQUIRED

functions.label: Pozastavit
functions.disabledWhen: no run OR phase not pausable

functions.label: Pokračovat
functions.enabledWhen: paused checkpoint current and dependencies valid

functions.label: Rollback
functions.enabledWhen: valid rollback point exists and safety checks PASS
functions.disabledWhen: no rollback point OR incompatible migration/effect

functions.label: Odeslat request
functions.enabledWhen: all request fields valid and selected contract current

functions.label: Aktivovat
functions.disabledWhen: era unknown/ambiguous OR any gate fail

functions.label: Opravit
functions.disabledWhen: no repair basis OR duplicate active repair

functions.label: Otevřít URL
functions.enabledWhen: controller has write lease and URL valid
functions.disabledWhen: no control lease OR stale page/document identity

functions.label: Převzít ovládání
functions.enabledWhen: current session controllable and not already OWNER

functions.label: Vrátit AI
functions.enabledWhen: OWNER current controller + AI consumer attached + challenge resolved
functions.disabledWhen: not controller OR no AI recipient OR stale epoch

functions.label: Procházet
functions.disabledWhen: OWNER not controller for page input

functions.label: Uložit označení
functions.enabledWhen: draft geometry valid and lineage unchanged
functions.disabledWhen: pointer-up lineage changed without snapshot-only resolution

functions.label: Požádat AI: zaměř se sem
functions.enabledWhen: >=1 resolvable/snapshot annotation selected and AI consumer attached
functions.disabledWhen: no annotation OR no AI recipient

functions.label: Uložit účet
functions.enabledWhen: account marker verified and no unresolved effect

functions.label: Vytvořit automatizaci
functions.disabledWhen: visual-only unresolved mutating step OR model-only replay
